name: ai-proxy-remote-chat
description: Drive VS Code's chat panel (Copilot Chat / Continue / Cursor) from any HTTP client.

chatParticipants.name: proxy
chatParticipants.description: Chat with phone-approved tool execution. Tools queue to your phone for approve/deny.

aiProxyRemoteChat.port.description: TCP port to listen on for incoming chat-prompt requests.

aiProxyRemoteChat.bind.description: Bind address. Use 0.0.0.0 to accept LAN connections (firewall accordingly).

aiProxyRemoteChat.token.description: Required Bearer token. Empty = no auth (only safe with 127.0.0.1 bind).

aiProxyRemoteChat.defaultCommand.description: Default VS Code command to invoke. Try 'github.copilot-chat.openChat' for Copilot, or 'workbench.action.chat.openInSidebar'.

aiProxyRemoteChat.proxyUrl.description: Optional AI Proxy URL (e.g. http://192.168.6.183:11444). When set, this extension self-registers so the proxy's phone PWA can route prompts here.

aiProxyRemoteChat.advertiseUrl.description: URL the proxy should call back on, e.g. http://192.168.6.113:13337. If empty, advertises bind+port from this extension.

aiProxyRemoteChat.advertiseName.description: Friendly name to register with (defaults to OS hostname).

aiProxyRemoteChat.newChatCommand.description: Command to run BEFORE the prompt when the request includes 'newChat': true. Try 'github.copilot.chat.newChat' for Copilot, 'workbench.action.chat.newEditSession' for Edits mode.

aiProxyRemoteChat.submitCommand.description: Command to run AFTER the prompt to force submission. Some chat extensions only pre-fill the input from `query` instead of submitting; this is the belt-and-suspenders fallback.

aiProxyRemoteChat.alwaysSubmit.description: Run submitCommand after every prompt to force submission (works around chat extensions that don't auto-submit on the `query` arg).

aiProxyRemoteChat.participantApprovalTim.description: Seconds to wait for phone approval before treating @proxy tool calls as denied.

aiProxyRemoteChat.participantPollInterva.description: Polling interval (seconds) for the @proxy participant to check approval status.
